@SkanerSoft Could you do the following?

- Upgrade to [4.5.2.rc1](https://godotengine.org/article/release-candidate-godot-4-5-2-rc-1/) or later, which fixes a lot of production crashes on Android for Vulkan (Mali, Adreno) and OpenGL (PowerVR), as well as ANRs when closing the app.
  * If you don't mind being on the cutting edge, you can also upgrade to [4.6.rc2](https://godotengine.org/article/release-candidate-godot-4-6-rc-2/) or later.
- Download the native debug symbols for the version you're using, and upload them to Google Play. See https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.6/tutorials/platform/android/resolving_crashes_on_android.html for details.
- When crashes occur, you should now have proper debug information about which functions are involved in `libgodot_android.so`. You can search for some of those function names on https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues with the `platform:android` and `crash` labels to see if it's already reported. If it isn't, please file ONE bug report per crash with a unique stacktrace.
